name: medical-clinic-system-monorepo
description: General Medical Clinic Management System Monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for(const p of ['backend/dist','frontend/dist','shared/dist']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
